scope_limit: Leaf service-port injection, direct-service TCP probe forwarding, VIP HTTP, and one controlled report-only UDP burst with service-interface packet capture and a collector relay ledger; no matched data-plane packet-loss burst or Agent result is included.
counter_delta_interpretation: Per-port packet deltas cover each controlled probe window, not individual flow attribution; the single loss arm cannot establish separation from report-only loss. Raw snapshots are retained for reset/wrap inspection.

background_burst_profile.service_sink_instrumentation: Evaluator UDP sockets pre-bind the flow ports and replace NIKA's non-logging sink for this preflight; built-in sink attempts cannot bind.

service_udp_packet_capture.scope: report-only fault arm; business path remains healthy; interface arrival only

service_collector_packet_join.interpretation: A join compares IPv4 identification within the exporter flow key. The burst is a report-only fault arm: service arrival is observed, targeted sink reports are relayed/dropped, and upstream reports remain collector-visible. No matched data-plane-loss arm or Agent is included.

service_udp_socket_receipt.observation_point: evaluator-owned UDP sockets on service ports
service_udp_socket_receipt.scope: report-only fault arm; application socket receipt, without payload modification
